digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center test harness / external integration tier
propositions: There is no way to acquire a Jira Data Center license for testing; Atlassian ended DC purchases on 30 March 2026 and no longer issues trial licenses, and there is no official OpenAPI/Swagger spec for Jira DC, only WADL.

A vendored Dockerfile must build locally FROM the addono/jira-software-standalone base image pinned by digest, with mandatory entrypoint flags -DskipAllPrompts=true and -Dproduct.start.timeout to prevent container death on slow runners.

The Jira 8.17.1 instance must be exercised on a native amd64 runner via a new CI job in external-integration.yml, because the base image is amd64-only and emulation on arm64 causes startup to exceed Cargo's default 600000ms timeout and fail silently.

Personal Access Token bearer authentication must be verified live by creating a token programmatically via POST /rest/pat/latest/tokens and using it in an Authorization: Bearer request, proving DC's auth mode works against a real 8.x instance.
Teardown verification must be index-independent: every created issue must return 404 from its direct /rest/api/2/issue/{key} endpoint, never consulted via search, per ADR 0037 §3.

The harness tests must live under tests/external/ with a _live_jira_ready sentinel so they participate in the all-skip canary, skip cleanly without REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1 plus a running instance, and cannot break per-commit CI.
